start: Member with records on bench press and squat, kg

steps.action: Profile tab, tap 'Records' ('Your best weights and reps')
user_sees: Page 'Records' listing each record with a badge naming its kind
must_not: 'Plank 0 kg' or another first bodyweight or timed set as a record
An assisted move's help shown as a minus record

steps.action: Go back and look at the Profile header
must_not: A number different from the records the page counts

start: Active workout, bench press best 80 kg x 5

steps.action: Tick a set of 85 kg x 5
user_sees: A record pop-up naming the exercise and the record, with a sound
must_not: A second pop-up for the same exercise later in this workout

steps.action: Tick a set of 80 kg x 6 on another exercise card that is not a record but beats last time
user_sees: One quiet line saying how it beat last time
must_not: A record claimed for a drop set or a warm-up

start: Monthly report or a dated link to Records with no new bests in that span

user_sees: 'No new bests' for the span and the button 'See all records'
must_not: 'No records yet' when older records exist

user_sees: 'No records yet' with 'Beat a previous best and it lands here.'
must_not: A record for a set of 0 kg

start: Active workout in an easy week

steps.action: Tick a set heavier than the best
must_not: The easy week set counted as a record

start: A workout that set the bench press record

user_sees: The record goes back to the best before it, on Records and the Profile header

steps.action: Choose 'Start records fresh' for bench press
user_sees: Older workouts no longer count for its records; History keeps them
